elevated.comment: The design's #eef0f6, moved dE 0.30. At the design value: the rail's current row lifts off the rail, measured dE 1.26 >= 1.5.

pressed.comment: A step the kit draws from surface-hover: the design draws no pressed row; a press is a stronger hover. At that value: a pressed row is visible over a hovered one, measured dE 0.00 >= 3 from a hovered row on it.

tertiary.comment: The design's #5a6075, moved dE 0.71. At the design value: text step clears its floor, measured 4.37:1 >= 4.5, worst on a pressed row on the frame.

muted.comment: The design's #8a90a3, moved dE 1.04. At the design value: text-muted is decoration, measured 2.8 < 2.69:1 < 4.5 on the frame.

hatch.comment: The arranging hatch's line: strong at 60% over the sheet. A board under construction draws its diagonals in it, and so does a note standing on that board, which is why it is a colour of its own and not the strong border faded on a layer.

control.comment: The design's #8a90a3, moved dE 7.63. At the design value: a mark on a data surface clears its floor on every ground it lands on, measured 2.69:1 >= 3 (a chart's connector between two cards, worst on the frame); a control boundary clears 3:1, measured 2.23:1, worst on a pressed row on the frame.

field.comment: The strong border, #c9cfdc, darkened dE 22.72: the least move that clears 3:1 on every rung a text field sits on (3.00:1 on the frame, the worst). A field stands on a rung and never inside a hovered or pressed row, so it is held to the rungs alone rather than to the composites the control boundary clears, and it reads as quietly as a secondary button's edge allows.

focus.comment: A step the kit draws from brand-accent: the ring is drawn in the accent.

success.comment: The design's #0a8f63, moved dE 1.64. At the design value: status hues stay separable, measured dE n19.7/p8.4/d12.3 >= 10.

danger.comment: The design's #cc2a4a, moved dE 6.23.
